## Overview

`v26.3-alpha` is the first pre-release for Minecraft `26.3`, following `v26.2-r1`. It introduces major world-generation, equipment, crafting, storage, and endgame utility updates, together with extensive model, texture, interface, and internal code changes.

This release redesigns the three main dimensions, adds five biomes and the `Star Atlas`, reworks Supreme equipment into the Emperor family, expands the custom crafting grids, and introduces Universe enchantments, potions, and dimension-reset functionality.

## Changes

- Reworked `Harvest Continent` terrain and biome generation.
  - Replaced the previous biome distribution with a continuous, seed-based `Harvestour` field, enlarged biome regions, and reduced isolated micro-biomes.
  - Rebuilt terrain profiles and transitions between lakes, marshes, plains, deserts, snowfields, gorges, jungles, and mountains.
  - Expanded the dimension's vertical generation range from 384 to 640 blocks and reworked cave generation beneath the surface.
  - Redesigned `Great Lake` shores and `Lake Center Island` placement.
  - Rebuilt `Melon Jungle` terrain with more varied relief and smoother transitions into neighboring regions.
  - Adjusted `Pumpkin Gorge` terrain to approximately Y=80–150 and reduced Golden Tree placement in `Wheat Plain`.
  - Added four biomes: `Sacred Mountain`, a rare snowy mountain region; `Sugarcane Marsh`, a wet lowland region; `Cactus Desert`, with tall cacti; and `Berry Snowfield`, with berry patches, giant blue-ice spikes, and a gray sky.
  - Reworked animal replenishment, population limits, and biome-specific spawn selection.
  - Added extra surface monster spawning in `Cactus Desert`, respecting difficulty and mob-spawning rules.

- Updated `Ore Continent` biome generation.
  - Added `Ore Plain`, an open biome with sparse mineral trees.
  - Replaced the previous biome selection with the continuous `Oretour` field.
  - Distributed `Ore Forest`, `Ore Plain`, and `Ore Land` across approximately equal long-term area shares.
  - Reduced `Ore Forest` tree-placement density and updated mineral-tree generation resources.

- Redesigned the `Universe Meta` origin structure and atmosphere.
  - Replaced the previous origin cube generator with a registered world-generation structure.
  - Added a 23×23 origin platform containing a central portal, `Universe Libraries`, a `Universe Forge`, a `Universe Pool`, a `Universe Dot`, and a `Prime Ultimate Block`.
  - Structure generation now handles each intersecting chunk independently.
  - Removed visible clouds and updated the blue sky and fog colors.

- Added `Star Atlas` for biome exploration.
  - Opens an interactive biome-prediction map for the current dimension, including areas beyond already explored terrain.
  - Supports dragging to pan, scrolling to zoom, centering on the player, and inspecting biome names and coordinates.
  - Uses dedicated colors for Magnatour and many vanilla biomes, with stable fallback colors for other biome identifiers.
  - Calculates and delivers map predictions progressively.

- Redesigned `Gold Bell Tower` generation and encounters.
  - Updated the structure templates and appearance, added random rotation, and tightened terrain checks around shorelines and uneven islands.
  - Updated candidate-cell selection to a deterministic two-thirds selection rate, subject to terrain suitability.
  - Reworked `Bell Ringer` and `Bell Soul` population targets and valid interior spawn locations.
  - Ringing a bell in an active tower has a 10% chance to kill monsters inside the structure and disable its custom guard spawning. Otherwise, the bell explodes and attempts to summon four Bell Ringers and four Bell Souls.
  - Ringing another bell in a subdued tower restores spawning; the tower's subdued state persists across saves.
  - Rebalanced chest loot with larger quantities of resources and food.

- Rebuilt `Diamond City` and its defenders.

...

## Overview 
 
`v26.2-r1` is the first stable release for Minecraft `26.2`, following `v26.2-rc`. 
 
All content and fixes from `v26.2-rc` are carried over unchanged. This release only updates the mod version from `26.2-rc-fabric` to `26.2-r1-fabric`; no additional gameplay changes or fixes are introduced. 
 
## Compatibility 
 
- Minecraft `26.2` 
- Fabric Loader `0.19.3+`

releases.notes:
## Overview

  `v26.2-rc` is the release candidate after `v26.2-beta`, focused on world-generation and gameplay fixes, plus stability improvements for remote access and enhanced furnaces.

  ## Fixes

  - Fixed `Town of Fortune` generation ignoring its biome restrictions.
  - Aligned the `Ore Continent` generator's minimum Y level with the dimension height.
  - Fixed `Universe Guardian` failing to follow its owner across dimensions.
  - Prevented a division-by-zero case when `Universe Guardian` uses its sonic boom at zero distance.
  - Fixed remote chunks remaining loaded when a `Universe Console` interaction opens no menu.
  - Allowed an existing `Universe Teleport Point` destination to be overwritten when its destination list is full.
  - Prevented fuel duration overflow in the `Supreme Furnace` and `Universe Refinery`.

  ## Compatibility

  - Minecraft `26.2`
  - Fabric Loader `0.19.3+`
  - Java `25+`

  ## Compare

  [v26.2-beta...v26.2-rc](https://github.com/roeyqian/Magnatour/compare/v26.2-beta...v26.2-rc)

releases.notes:
## Overview

  `v26.2-beta` is the next pre-release after `v26.1.2-r1`. It ports Magnatour to Minecraft `26.2` and introduces major world-generation, structure, and endgame exploration updates.

  ## Changes

  - Added `Universe Meta`, a new void-based Universe dimension.
    - Its first generation creates a persistent 64×64×64 solid cube at the origin, built from `Death Blocks` with reinforced `Rebirth Block` borders.
    - Added an End-Portal-style `Universe Meta Portal`: activate the 12 non-corner blocks of a 5×5 `Universe Block` frame to create its 3×3 portal center.
    - Portals support linked Overworld and Universe Meta destinations, safe return-portal creation, and persistent links after server restarts.
    - Survival players teleport after 80 game ticks in the portal; Creative players teleport instantly.
    - Added the `Universe Meta` advancement and related models, textures, and localizations.
  - Reworked `Harvest Continent` terrain generation.
    - Improved large-scale biome layout and terrain blending around Great Lakes.
    - Prevented small fragmented micro-biomes and smoothed biome boundaries.
    - Increased farm-animal replenishment in the dimension.
  - Added custom `Ore Continent` generation with `Ore Land` and `Ore Forest` biomes, ore-tree features, and adjusted structure generation balance.
  - Added `Town of Fortune`, including settlement generation, villagers, and livestock replenishment.
  - Refined `Diamond City` and `Gold Bell Tower` generation, lighting, chain connections, clock presentation, and structure mob spawning.
  - Refreshed the `Item Hub` presentation and several item textures.

  ## Internal

  - Reorganized registry, networking, world-generation, renderer, screen, and mixin-helper code to support the new content and improve maintainability.
  - Updated the mod environment and build configuration for Minecraft `26.2`, including Fabric API and Fabric Loom updates.

  ## Compatibility

  - Minecraft `26.2`
  - Fabric Loader `0.19.3+`
  - Java `25+`

  ## Compare

  https://github.com/roeyqian/Magnatour/compare/v26.1.2-r1...v26.2-beta
